propwash.input.leds.held_off: LEDs stay off: the “%s” switch on your radio is active
propwash.input.leds.no_strip: This drone has no LED strip
propwash.input.channel_axis.tooltip:
%s: %s

Which axis this channel reads. If the axis already belongs to another channel, the two are swapped. Switches on the axis move to the freed axis. Scroll wheel or Shift+click steps backwards.
propwash.input.switches_moved: Axis is now a stick, switches moved:
propwash.input.invert.tooltip: Reverse %s if the stick works the wrong way round.
propwash.input.binding.mode.tooltip: Hold: active while the switch or button is in position. Toggle: each actuation switches on or off.
propwash.input.device.tooltip: Which radio or gamepad is read. “Automatic” takes the most recently used device that is set up, otherwise radios before gamepads. “Keyboard” always flies with the keyboard, even when a controller is connected.
propwash.input.layout.tooltip: Gamepad layout uses SDL's standard mapping (sticks, triggers, buttons). Raw axes reads the axes directly, which is right for radios in USB joystick mode. Switching resets the mapping to defaults.
Throttle over the whole stick travel: bottom = off, top = full. Right for radios with a non-centering throttle stick.
Stick centered = throttle off, up = more throttle. For spring-centered gamepad sticks.
propwash.input.throttle_mode.incremental: The stick changes throttle gradually and holds it when released (like cruise control). Good for starting out with a gamepad.
propwash.input.keyboard_fallback.tooltip: Fly with the keyboard when no radio or gamepad is connected. Change the keys in the configurator's Keys tab.
propwash.input.tab.open_wizard.tooltip: Guides you through device selection, channel mapping, calibration and switches. After “Done” the device counts as set up and loads without asking when plugged in. Pending changes in this tab are applied first.
propwash.input.modes.source.tooltip: AUX channel (any axis that is not a stick) or a radio button. Scroll wheel or Shift+click steps backwards.
propwash.input.modes.assign.tooltip: Shortcut: click, then flip the switch into the position in which the function should be active. Source and range are filled in automatically.
propwash.input.modes.invert.tooltip_axis: Inverted: reverses the switch – positions swap their order, the range is mirrored at 1500 µs.
propwash.input.modes.invert.tooltip_butt: Inverted: swaps on and off – active while the button is released.
propwash.input.modes.invert.tooltip_togg: Inverted: swaps on and off of the latch – every press still toggles.
propwash.input.modes.invert.tooltip_arm: If this turns Arm on, the drone stays disarmed until the switch has been turned off and on again.
propwash.input.modes.header_invert.toolt: Inverted: reverse a switch – swaps on and off, 3-position switches reverse their order, ranges are mirrored.
propwash.input.modes.range_tooltip: Active from %s to %s µs · now %s µs
propwash.input.modes.on_stick.tooltip: Warning: %s is the %s stick channel. This assignment switches while you steer. Pick an AUX channel or a button.
propwash.input.modes.unbound_hint: Not assigned – pick a source or click “Flip switch”.
propwash.input.modes.hint: Click a row to edit it · drag the range edges or type min/max (900–2100 µs, steps of 25)
propwash.input.modes.hint_keyboard: Every function has its own key – change them in the Keys tab.
propwash.input.modes.key_override: %s chosen by key – flipping a mode switch on the radio takes over again
propwash.input.modes.open_controls.toolt: Opens the Keys tab: change every Propwash key there.
propwash.input.wizard.title: Receiver wizard
propwash.input.wizard.reset.tooltip: Resets channels, calibration and switches of this device to the default mapping.
propwash.input.wizard.layout_reset: Read mode changed – mapping reset to defaults
propwash.input.wizard.no_device: No radio and no gamepad found.
propwash.input.wizard.no_sdl: Controller support (SDL) could not be started. See the log for details.
propwash.input.wizard.no_device_hint: Connect your radio via USB and select “USB Joystick (HID)” in EdgeTX/OpenTX. Gamepads are detected automatically.
propwash.input.wizard.keyboard_hint: Until then you can fly with the keyboard: %s adds throttle, %s arms (change the keys in the configurator's Keys tab).
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.waiting: Waiting for the throttle – wherever it rests now does not matter.
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.too_small: Travel %s%% – push the throttle fully UP to the stop, then fully DOWN to the stop.
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.one_end: One end ✔ – now pull the throttle fully DOWN and hold it there.
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.stuck: Pull the throttle fully DOWN and hold it there. Already down? Push it fully UP once more, then straight back DOWN.
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.holding: Is the throttle fully DOWN (off)? Then keep holding… Still at the TOP? Pull it DOWN now!
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.confirm: Quick check so the direction is right for sure: where is your throttle right now?
propwash.input.wizard.throttle.confirm.t: The throttle rested at the other end when this step started, or the direction differs from your current setting. Tell the wizard where it is now – or simply pull it DOWN and hold it there.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_arm: Most important first: the arm switch. Click “Assign” next to “Arm” and flip the switch you want to arm with.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_arm_ok: Flip your arm switch: the lamp next to “Arm” must light up. Does another lamp or none light up? Then click “Assign” and flip the right switch.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_arm_ok_sh: Flip your arm switch: the lamp next to “Arm” must light up.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_arm_short: Most important: assign your arm switch next to “Arm”.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_listening: Now flip the switch or press the button for “%s”. Esc cancels.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_card: “%s”: click “Assign”, then flip the switch like this.
propwash.input.wizard.finish_no_arm.text: Without an arm switch, only the %1$s key arms the drone. “%2$s” takes you to the switches, “%3$s” completes the setup as it is.
propwash.input.demo.title: Like this
propwash.input.demo.tour_roll: Roll: to the right and back
propwash.input.demo.tour_yaw: Yaw: to the right and back
propwash.input.demo.circles: big circles to the end stops
propwash.input.wizard.too_small: Further – all the way to the end stop.
propwash.input.wizard.ambiguous: Several axes moved – move only the stick asked for.
propwash.input.wizard.check: Check every stick: throttle down = 1000 and up = 2000; roll right, pitch forward and yaw right go above 1500. If one moves the wrong way, set it to “Inv.”.
propwash.input.wizard.channels_hint: Only move the stick asked for and let go of the others. The detected axis lights up yellow.
propwash.input.wizard.channels_prefilled: If the pre-filled mapping (gray) is already right, go straight to “To calibration”.
propwash.input.wizard.skip_channel.toolt: Keeps the current mapping of this channel and moves on.
propwash.input.wizard.calibrate_center: Let go of all sticks (centered) and put the throttle stick in the middle. Then “Capture center”.
propwash.input.wizard.calibrate_extremes: Now move all sticks to their end stops several times (big circles). Then “Apply”.
propwash.input.wizard.calibrate_review: Calibration applied. Check: center = 1500, end stops = 1000 and 2000.
propwash.input.wizard.switches_hint: Click “Assign” and flip the switch into the position for the function. “Inv.” reverses a switch; ranges and buttons can be set freely in the “Modes” tab afterwards.
propwash.input.wizard.setup_done: Set up – this profile loads automatically when you plug the device in.
propwash.input.wizard.prefill_radio: Not set up yet – pre-filled with AETR and switches on channels 5–8. Usually “Next”, “To calibration” and calibrating are enough.
propwash.input.wizard.prefill_gamepad: Not set up yet – pre-filled for %1$s (%2$s). Usually “Next” and calibrating are enough.
propwash.input.setup.question: Set it up now? The receiver wizard walks you through channels, calibration and switches in about a minute.
propwash.input.setup.prefill_radio: Already pre-filled: channels AETR, arm on channel 5, flight mode on channel 6 (low Acro, middle Horizon, high Angle), beeper on 7, rescue on 8. Usually you just confirm and calibrate.
propwash.input.setup.prefill_gamepad: Already pre-filled: %1$s (%2$s), arm on RB, Angle on LB. Usually you just confirm.
propwash.input.setup.hint: Anytime later: configurator (%s) → Receiver → receiver wizard.
propwash.input.setup.later.title: Setup postponed
propwash.input.setup.later.message: Propwash will remind you once later. Anytime: configurator (%s) → Receiver.
propwash.input.setup.later.final: No more reminders this session. Anytime: configurator (%s) → Receiver.
propwash.input.setup.never.title: No more prompts
propwash.input.setup.never.message: Propwash won't ask again for this device. Set it up anytime: configurator (%s) → Receiver.
propwash.input.setup.toast.after_menu: %s – setup once this menu is closed
propwash.input.keys.click: Click, then press the new key or mouse button for: %s
propwash.input.keys.hint: Click a key, then press the new key or a mouse button. ESC while waiting clears the key. Unbound stick keys follow the movement keys (W/A/S/D). Save applies the keys.
propwash.input.modes.legend.led: Lamp: lights up while the function is on
propwash.input.modes.no_device_short: No radio: turn on keyboard flight in the Receiver tab.
propwash.input.modes.acro_device: On while Angle and Horizon are off
propwash.input.modes.effect.horizon: Self-levels, but full stick still flips
propwash.input.modes.effect.rescue: Flies back to the home point
propwash.input.modes.effect.reset: Drone back to its home point – level and disarmed
propwash.input.modes.desc.arm: Switches the motors on and off. Arm with the throttle at zero; disarming stops the props at once.
propwash.input.modes.desc.acro: The drone keeps its angle until you steer back – nothing levels it out. Full control for freestyle and racing. On while Angle and Horizon are off; key or switch, the last input counts.
propwash.input.modes.desc.angle: Release the sticks and the drone levels out by itself; the tilt is limited. The easiest mode to learn.
propwash.input.modes.desc.horizon: Levels out near the stick center like Angle, but full stick deflection still rolls or flips the drone.
propwash.input.modes.desc.rescue: GPS rescue: the drone climbs, flies back to the home point and lands. Switch it off again to take over.
propwash.input.modes.desc.flip_over: Turns a crashed drone upright again. It has to be disarmed and lying still.
propwash.input.modes.desc.set_home: Stores where the drone is now as the home point that GPS rescue flies back to.
propwash.input.modes.desc.beeper: Switches the locator beeper on or off – to find a crashed drone by its sound.
propwash.input.modes.desc.reset: Puts the drone back on its home point: level, disarmed, standing still. A running race is canceled. Needs the world rule “Allow reset”.
propwash.input.modes.desc.record: Starts and stops the action cam recording while you fly FPV. A switch records while it is on; a button starts and stops with every press. Needs an action cam on top of the frame; find your videos in the “Action cam” tab under “Recordings”.
propwash.input.modes.desc.leds_off: Switches the LED strip and the FPV headlight off while the function is active – like LED_LOW in Betaflight. Other players see it too. Without an assignment the LEDs glow as set in the “LED strip” tab.
propwash.input.modes.desc.alt_hold: Self-levels like Angle and holds altitude with the barometer, never exactly (about ±0.3–1 m). Throttle near its position when switched on holds, more climbs, less descends – at a limited rate. Values in the "PID Tuning" tab.
propwash.input.modes.desc.pos_hold: Holds altitude and position with GPS (1–3 m accurate, drifts and corrects slowly). Needs open sky: under blocks, in caves or ravines there are too few satellites, then the OSD shows "NO GPS" and only altitude is held.
propwash.input.keys.shared: Shares the key with: %s. In flight it cycles the flight mode, with a gate or the course tool in hand it rotates gates.
propwash.input.apple_gc.tooltip: Detect controllers through Apple's GameController framework. Off (default): radios such as the Radiomaster Pocket are detected reliably, PlayStation, Switch Pro and Xbox controllers keep using SDL's own drivers. On: only needed for pure MFi gamepads that macOS offers through this framework alone – some radios then disappear. Propwash searches for controllers again right after saving.
propwash.input.apple_gc.locked: Set by the environment variable SDL_JOYSTICK_MFI=%s in your launcher. Remove the variable to switch it here.
propwash.input.wizard.no_device_hint.mac: macOS: a pure MFi gamepad that only works through Apple's GameController framework shows up once you turn on “Apple GameController” in the Receiver tab.
macOS: a pure MFi gamepad that only works through Apple's GameController framework shows up once you turn on “Apple GameController” under “Advanced (macOS)”.
macOS: “Apple GameController” is on. If your radio is missing, turn it off in the Receiver tab – otherwise macOS takes over some radios without passing them on.
macOS: “Apple GameController” is on. If your radio is missing, turn it off under “Advanced (macOS)” – otherwise macOS takes over some radios without passing them on.
macOS: the environment variable SDL_JOYSTICK_MFI=%s from your launcher decides whether Apple's GameController framework takes over controllers (0 = off, better for radios).
propwash.input.modes.effect.cargo_drop: Opens the gripper and drops the cargo
propwash.input.modes.desc.cargo_drop: Opens the gripper and drops the cargo, best on a button. Needs a gripper on the bottom mount; without an assignment the “Cargo drop” key (Enter) drops it, and landing or a hard crash opens it too.
propwash.input.modes.desc.accessory_1: For add-on accessories, best on a button: pressing triggers the action, releasing ends it. The accessory decides what happens, for example firing a launcher or switching a camera mode. Without an assignment the “Accessory action 1” key (numpad 9) does the same.
propwash.input.modes.desc.accessory_2: For add-on accessories, best on a button: pressing triggers the action, releasing ends it. The accessory decides what happens, for example firing a launcher or switching a camera mode. Without an assignment the “Accessory action 2” key (numpad 0) does the same.
propwash.input.modes.desc.accessory_3: For add-on accessories, best on a button: pressing triggers the action, releasing ends it. The accessory decides what happens, for example firing a launcher or switching a camera mode. Without an assignment the “Accessory action 3” key (numpad Enter) does the same.
propwash.input.modes.desc.accessory_4: For add-on accessories, best on a button: pressing triggers the action, releasing ends it. The accessory decides what happens, for example firing a launcher or switching a camera mode. Without an assignment the “Accessory action 4” key (numpad +) does the same.
propwash.input.modes.desc.blackbox: Logs the flight to the blackbox only while the switch is on, like the BLACKBOX mode in Betaflight. Without an assignment the blackbox logs every armed flight once it is switched on in the “Blackbox” tab.
propwash.input.modes.effect.mode_3d: Throttle center = zero thrust, down = reverse thrust
propwash.input.modes.desc.mode_3d: Reversible motors like with 3D ESCs: throttle down = full reverse thrust, center = idle, up = full forward thrust. Fly upside down, save botched loops and take off upside down after a crash. Arm only with the throttle centered; switching it off brings normal throttle back at once.
propwash.input.modes.mode_3d.unlock.tool: Unlocks 3D mode for you (personal setting). Then bind it to a switch or the key like the other modes. Whether it is allowed in a world is decided by the world rule “3D mode allowed”.
propwash.input.modes.mode_3d.unlock_firs: Unlock it first, then bind it to a switch or the key.
propwash.input.modes.key_override_3d_on: 3D mode on by key – the radio switch counts again as soon as you move it.
propwash.input.modes.key_override_3d_off: 3D mode off by key – the radio switch counts again as soon as you move it.
propwash.input.wizard.calibrate_center_3: 3D mode is unlocked: the throttle center is your zero thrust. Put the throttle stick exactly in the middle before you press “Capture center”.
propwash.input.wizard.calibrate_review_3: Throttle center for 3D mode: %s µs (zero thrust, deadband ±50 µs).
gamerule.propwash.allow_3d_mode.descript: Pilots may use 3D mode (reversible motors, throttle center = zero thrust) once they have unlocked it for themselves. Off: Propwash doesn't let anyone switch it on, for example on race servers where nobody should brake with reverse thrust. Like the flight model, the rule is applied by each pilot's game.
propwash.input.modes.page.flight.tooltip: Flight functions: arming, flight modes, rescue and more
propwash.input.modes.page.commands.toolt: Custom commands 1–8: put your own Minecraft commands on switches and keys
propwash.input.modes.commands.hint: Flipping the switch runs its command as if typed in chat – only while flying, never with a menu open.
propwash.input.modes.desc.command: Runs a Minecraft command of your choice when you flip the switch or press the key – exactly as if you typed it in chat, with your own permissions – and optionally a second one when you flip it back. Only while you fly a drone and no menu is open.
propwash.input.command.edit.tooltip: Enter the Minecraft command for switching on and, if you like, one for switching off. Double-clicking a row opens it too.
propwash.input.command.edit.title: Set up %s
propwash.input.command.edit.on: When switched on (switch on, button or key pressed)
propwash.input.command.edit.too_long: Too long: %s of at most %s characters (chat limit)
propwash.input.command.edit.illegal: Contains characters the chat doesn't allow
propwash.input.command.edit.unknown: Unknown here or not allowed for you – it is still sent, the server decides
propwash.input.command.edit.rules: Runs as if you typed it in chat: with your own permissions, the server decides. Only while you fly a drone and no menu is open, at most one command per switch every half second. A key runs the on command; with an off command, every press alternates. Up to %s characters, the slash is optional.
propwash.input.command.toast.unknown.hin: %s seems unknown or not allowed – see chat
propwash.input.command.toast.screen_open: Close the menu first – commands only run without an open menu.
propwash.input.command.toast.rate_limite: Too many commands in a row – wait a moment.
propwash.input.command.toast.empty.hint: Set it up in the configurator: Modes → Commands.
propwash.input.command.toast.invalid.hin: Longer than %s characters or with forbidden characters – please set it up again.
propwash.input.mouse.search: mouse aim aiming mouse flight DPI wheel
propwash.input.mouse.mode.auto.desc: Acro: mouse speed is stick deflection and the stick springs back when the mouse stops – the drone rotates while you move the mouse. Angle and Horizon: the stick stays where you push it – the drone stays tilted.
propwash.input.mouse.mode.rate.desc: Mouse speed is stick deflection, like aiming in a shooter. When the mouse stops, the stick springs back to center. Best for Acro.
propwash.input.mouse.mode.hold.desc: The stick stays where you push it with the mouse and slowly drifts back to center with the return speed. Best for Angle.
propwash.input.mouse.x_axis.tooltip: Roll: the mouse tilts the drone sideways, A/D yaw. Yaw: the mouse turns the nose like looking around, A/D then roll. Yaw always follows the mouse speed.
propwash.input.mouse.sensitivity.label: Mouse sensitivity
propwash.input.mouse.sensitivity.tooltip: At 100% the mouse gives full deflection at 30 cm/s (Speed mode) or after 6 cm of travel (Hold mode). Higher = less mouse travel.
propwash.input.mouse.dpi.label: Mouse DPI
propwash.input.mouse.dpi.tooltip: Enter your mouse's DPI (often 800, 1600 or 3200). Then the sensitivity means the same travel on your desk with any mouse.
propwash.input.invert_pitch.tooltip: Off: moving the mouse forward or pressing the nose-down key tilts the nose down like a stick pushed forward, and the drone flies forward. On: reversed – mouse forward raises the nose like looking up in a shooter, and the two pitch keys swap. Applies to mouse + keyboard and to keyboard-only flight. A radio or gamepad has its own “Inverted” switch per channel.
propwash.input.invert_pitch.search: invert inverted reverse reversed flip pitch nose mouse Y keyboard
propwash.input.mouse.smoothing.label: Mouse smoothing
propwash.input.mouse.smoothing.tooltip: Mouse speed is averaged over this time (Speed mode and yaw only). 0 ms uses every frame on its own. More smoothing is calmer but reacts later. There is no other smoothing.
propwash.input.mouse.deadzone.label: Mouse deadzone
propwash.input.mouse.deadzone.tooltip: The tiniest mouse movements around center do nothing. Helps you fly calmly in a straight line.
propwash.input.mouse.expo.label: Mouse expo
propwash.input.mouse.expo.tooltip: Makes the center finer and still allows full deflection at the edge. Works on top of the drone's rates.
propwash.input.mouse.return_speed.label: Return speed
propwash.input.mouse.return_speed.toolti: How fast the stick drifts back to center in Hold mode while the mouse stands still. Off = it stays until you push it back or center it.
propwash.input.mouse.wheel.label: Wheel throttle
propwash.input.mouse.wheel.tooltip: While flying, every notch of the mouse wheel changes throttle by this amount – on top of the throttle keys. The hotbar then doesn't change while you fly.
propwash.input.mouse.preview.title: Virtual sticks
propwash.input.mouse.pad.idle: Click and drag here to test the mouse
propwash.input.mouse.pad.active: Move the mouse – release to end the test
propwash.input.tab.status_mouse: Mouse + keyboard active – ready to fly
propwash.input.tab.status_mouse_pending: Mouse + keyboard selected – applies after saving
propwash.input.mouse.demo.title: How the mouse steers
propwash.input.mouse.demo.live: The radio shows what your mouse is doing right now
propwash.input.mouse.demo.start: The mouse moves the right stick
propwash.input.mouse.demo.right.roll: Mouse right: the drone rolls right
propwash.input.mouse.demo.right.yaw: Mouse right: the nose turns right
propwash.input.mouse.demo.stop_side.rate: Mouse stops: the stick springs back to center
propwash.input.mouse.demo.stop_side.hold: Mouse stops: the stick stays put
Mouse stops: the stick stays and slowly drifts to center
propwash.input.mouse.demo.stop_back: Small movements steer finely, fast ones fully
propwash.input.mouse.demo.forward.normal: Mouse forward: nose down, the drone flies forward
propwash.input.mouse.demo.stop_forward.r: Mouse stops: the stick springs back to center
propwash.input.mouse.demo.stop_forward.h: Mouse stops: the drone stays tilted
Mouse stops: the drone stays tilted and slowly levels out
propwash.input.mouse.wizard.hint: Set DPI, smoothing, return speed and the wheel in the Receiver tab.
propwash.input.mouse.wizard.finish.toolt: Saves the settings. In flight the mouse then steers, Esc frees the cursor.
propwash.input.mouse.wizard.intro: Mouse + keyboard: the mouse steers pitch and roll like aiming in a shooter. Throttle with %s/%s or the mouse wheel, yaw with %s/%s, %s arms. “Next” shows you how it works.
propwash.input.modes.effect.turtle: Flips a crashed drone over with its own props
propwash.input.modes.desc.turtle: Flip over after crash, like in Betaflight: switch it on while the drone lies upside down, arm, then push roll, pitch or yaw toward the side it should flip to. The props on that side spin backwards and lift it over; stick deflection or throttle sets the power, the motors stop once it is upright. Only on the ground, never in flight; switching it off disarms. If the drone keeps its motors running after crashes, look at the world rule “Disarm on crash”.
propwash.input.wizard.move.pitch.left: Push the LEFT stick (PITCH) fully FORWARD (up) and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.pitch.right: Push the RIGHT stick (PITCH) fully FORWARD (up) and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.roll.left: Move the LEFT stick (ROLL) fully to the RIGHT and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.roll.right: Move the RIGHT stick (ROLL) fully to the RIGHT and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.yaw.left: Move the LEFT stick (YAW) fully to the RIGHT and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.yaw.right: Move the RIGHT stick (YAW) fully to the RIGHT and hold it briefly.
propwash.input.wizard.move.throttle.left: LEFT stick (THROTTLE): push it fully UP first, then pull it fully DOWN and hold it there.
propwash.input.wizard.move.throttle.righ: RIGHT stick (THROTTLE): push it fully UP first, then pull it fully DOWN and hold it there.
propwash.input.mouse.demo.start.left: The mouse moves the left stick
propwash.input.mouse.demo.start.split: The mouse moves pitch on the %1$s stick, %2$s on the %3$s stick
propwash.input.stick_mode.tooltip: Which stick does what – set it like on your radio. Mode 2 (throttle and yaw on the left) is the most common. It changes what Propwash shows and says (receiver wizard, stick overlay, Flight School, the radio in your hand) and the default stick mapping of gamepads. A radio sends the same channels in every mode.
propwash.input.stick_mode.search: stick mode mode 1 2 3 4 mode1 mode2 mode3 mode4 sticks layout left right side throttle yaw pitch roll swap radio gamepad
propwash.input.stick_mode.mode_1.layout: left pitch and yaw, right throttle and roll
propwash.input.stick_mode.mode_2.layout: left throttle and yaw, right pitch and roll
propwash.input.stick_mode.mode_3.layout: left pitch and roll, right throttle and yaw
propwash.input.stick_mode.mode_4.layout: left throttle and roll, right pitch and yaw
propwash.input.stick_mode.custom: %s: your own gamepad stick mapping stays. The receiver wizard offers to switch it.
propwash.input.wizard.mode.intro: Which stick mode do you fly? Mode 2 is the most common. Pick it first – every picture and every prompt of the wizard then shows the right stick.
propwash.input.wizard.mode.radio: Radio: set the mode on the radio itself. It sends throttle, roll, pitch and yaw on the same channels (AETR) in every mode, so the channel mapping stays.
propwash.input.wizard.mode.gamepad: Gamepad: its sticks follow the mode you pick here.
propwash.input.wizard.mode.gamepad_custo: Gamepad: you set up its sticks yourself, so they stay as they are.
propwash.input.wizard.mode.apply_pad.too: Moves throttle, yaw, pitch and roll of this gamepad to the sticks of %s. The calibration is kept.
